advanced.modelMappingDesc: Map downstream model names to canonical models by rules. Three pattern forms: exact name, prefix wildcard (e.g. gpt-4*), and a single * as catch-all. Precedence is fixed: exact > longest prefix > catch-all. Exact aliases are listed in /v1/models. Hard: always rewrite to the target model. Soft: route with the original model first, falling back to the target only when the original has no available upstream (all cooling down or not deployed).
advanced.modelMappingLoading: Loading models available on enabled sites…
advanced.modelMappingNoModels: No canonical models are available on enabled sites
advanced.rateLimitDesc: Request rate limit. When disabled, only global config applies.
advanced.rpmDesc: Maximum in-flight requests for this key at any moment; excess requests queue for up to 60s. Leave empty for unlimited.
advanced.tpmDesc: Max tokens per minute for text models. Leave empty for unlimited.
advanced.imageBridgeDesc: When the upstream cannot generate images natively, the gateway executes it with the selected image model and returns the image per protocol. Incurs extra costs.
advanced.imageBridgeModelDesc: Only image models available on enabled sites are listed. This config itself authorizes the model.
advanced.imageBridgeSiteDesc: Only enabled sites offering the selected model are listed; auto routing picks a site by model.
advanced.imageBridgeNoModels: No image models available on enabled sites
